fieldValues.title: Skip the C4 unresolved-tag diagnostic entirely for open-mode vocabularies
fieldValues.summary: srs-usage.md states an open-mode vocabulary accepts any tag key, but validate_repository's C4 tag-resolution check downgraded an unresolved tag to a Warning instead of skipping it. Fixed the check in srs-repository/src/validation.rs to skip the diagnostic entirely when any vocabulary in the package is open; closed-mode vocabularies keep the Error unchanged. Flipped the existing open_vocab_unresolved_tag_produces_warning unit test to assert no diagnostic. Proved red-then-green over the srs spec corpus: 65 unresolved-tag warnings before the fix, 0 after, 0 errors either way.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs-rust gate:pool queue via srs#580. Owner ruling on srs-rust#702 (comment 5571808444, pooled at 5584388207): engine bug, not data — skip the warning entirely rather than downgrade. Mode clear, Cell Conformance, Door 1, gate:auto-merge. PR srs-rust#986 opened against master with auto-merge armed; both cargo gates (build, test --workspace, clippy -D warnings) green by exit code, SRS_SPEC_DIR pointed at a fresh origin/master clone of srs for the parity tests.
